BOOK ONE · LESSON 130

He can't have been... He must have been... 他那时不可能…… 他那时肯定是……

他那时不可能…… 他那时肯定是……

A picture lesson on past deduction: 'can't have been' (negative certainty about the past) and 'must have been' (positive certainty about the past). Eight pictures show deductions about a man's past condition, a hat, a woman's nationality, a man's job, ages, a date, family birth order and what a man was doing. The lesson introduces written exercises on completing sentences with 'had to' or 'must have been', and writing new sentences with 'can't have been' and 'must have been'. The workbook drills choosing the correct form of must / can't and reacting to situations; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'can't have been/done' and 'must have been/done'.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. He can't have been ill. He must have been tired.
2. It can't have been my new hat. It must have been my old one.
3. She can't have been Danish. She must have been Swedish.
4. He can't have been a dentist. He must have been a doctor.
5. She can't have been forty. She must have been fifty.
6. It can't have been the 20th. It must have been the 21st.
7. He can't have been the youngest. He must have been the oldest.
8. He can't have been reading. He must have been sleeping.

1. 他那时不可能生病了。他那时肯定是累了。
2. 那不可能是我的新帽子。那肯定是我旧的那顶。
3. 她那时不可能是丹麦人。她那时肯定是瑞典人。
4. 他那时不可能是牙医。他那时肯定是医生。
5. 她那时不可能四十岁。她那时肯定五十岁了。
6. 那不可能是二十号。那肯定是二十一号。
7. 他那时不可能是最小的。他那时肯定是最老的。
8. 他那时不可能在阅读。他那时肯定在睡觉。

Listen and answer the questions

听录音并回答问题。

One question per picture (8 pictures); the answer is the spoken past deduction from the picture captions.

Written A: Complete these sentences

完成以下句子，用 had to 或 must have been 填空。

完成以下句子，用 had to 或 must have been 填空。

6 fill-in items; 1 example printed on the page (He is very tired because he had to get up early this morning. → He didn't get up early this morning. He must have been tired.).

Written B: Write new sentences

模仿例句改写以下句子。

模仿例句改写以下句子。

20 rewrite items; 1 example printed on the page (I think she was Danish. (Swedish) → I don't think she was. She can't have been Danish. She must have been Swedish.).
